note: State direct cremation figures (Map V3.6/V3.7, Randy, November 2026). Washington: a published statewide survey average. Other states: medians calculated here from the direct cremation prices that Funeral Consumers Alliance affiliates publish for individual funeral homes, using only observations that share one definition. Figures are not inflation-adjusted and are never combined across states.

Washington.sample: People's Memorial Association surveyed 250 Washington funeral homes in 2024 (some did not participate); the average is of the prices reported.
Washington.definition: The price each funeral home lists for Direct Cremation on its General Price List. The survey does not state whether a cremation container or crematory fee is included.
Washington.source: People's Memorial Association, 2024 Funeral Home Price Survey

Arizona.coverage: statewide: all five regional reports, compiled from the Arizona State Board of Funeral Directors and Embalmers provider list
Arizona.sample: 174 funeral providers with a direct cremation price; member-discount (contracted provider) prices excluded.
Arizona.definition: Minimum "out the door" price from each provider's General Price List: removal within 25 miles, arrangements, permits and death certificate filing, refrigeration for at least 3 days, basic services fee, delivery to the crematory, the cremation, a basic alternative container and a basic urn.
Arizona.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Arizona, 2025 Funeral Provider Price Comparison Reports

Georgia.whenLabel: as listed November 2026 (price list dates vary)
Georgia.sample: 255 Georgia funeral homes with a listed direct cremation price (362 others are marked "needed").
Georgia.definition: Standardized package taken from each General Price List: basic services fee, removal within 30 miles, refrigeration up to 72 hours, alternative container, crematory fee, basic container for the ashes, death certificate filing and Social Security notification.
Georgia.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Georgia, Funeral Home Pricing Comparison

Maryland.sample: 116 of 258 Maryland establishments listed (those whose price includes the crematory fee).
Maryland.definition: The establishment's least expensive direct cremation price from its General Price List, listed as including the crematory fee; it does not include a cremation container or urn. Establishments whose price excludes the crematory fee, or may not include it, are left out.
Maryland.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Maryland and Environs, 2023 Mortuary Price Survey

Delaware.sample: 32 of 64 Delaware establishments listed (those whose price includes the crematory fee).
Delaware.definition: The establishment's least expensive direct cremation price from its General Price List, listed as including the crematory fee; it does not include a cremation container or urn. Establishments whose price excludes the crematory fee, or may not include it, are left out.
Delaware.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Maryland and Environs, 2023 Mortuary Price Survey

District of Columbia.sample: 15 of 31 District of Columbia establishments listed (those whose price includes the crematory fee).
District of Columbia.definition: The establishment's least expensive direct cremation price from its General Price List, listed as including the crematory fee; it does not include a cremation container or urn. Establishments whose price excludes the crematory fee, or may not include it, are left out.
District of Columbia.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Maryland and Environs, 2023 Mortuary Price Survey

Idaho.coverage: not statewide: responding mortuaries in Meridian, Boise, Payette, Emmett, Twin Falls and Lewiston
Idaho.sample: 9 responding mortuaries whose direct cremation price includes an alternative container; member-discount prices excluded.
Idaho.definition: Direct cremation with no services or viewing from each mortuary's General Price List, including an alternative container. The survey does not state whether the crematory fee is included.
Idaho.source: Funeral Consumers Alliance of Idaho, Comparative Cost of Funeral Services in Idaho, June 2024
